children.name: Thalia geniculata L.
children.description: Thalia geniculata, the bent alligator-flag, arrowroot, or fire-flag, is a plant species widespread across tropical Africa and much of the Americas.

children.name: Thalia multiflora Horkel ex Körn.
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. & S. Brazil to NE. Argentina. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Thalia pavonii Körn.
children.description: Thalia pavonii is a species of plant in the Marantaceae family.

children.name: Thalia petersiana K.Schum.
children.description: The native range of this species is Brazil (Rio de Janeiro). It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Thaumatococcus daniellii  Benth. ex Eichler
children.description: Thaumatococcus daniellii, also known as miracle fruit, is a plant species from tropical Africa of the Marantaceae (arrowroot and prayer plant) family.

children.name: Thaumatococcus flavus A.C.Ley
children.description: The native range of this species is Gabon. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
